prompt: The buying team is reviewing the products launched in March 2024 that cost Voltmarkt at least 100 euros. From the products table, return four columns, in this order: product_id, product_name, unit_cost_eur, launch_date. Keep only the products whose launch_date is from 1 March 2024 to 31 March 2024, both days included, and whose unit_cost_eur is 100 or more. launch_date is a date with no time of day, and every product has one. Show unit_cost_eur exactly as stored, without rounding. Return one row per product. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, write the row filter. Keep a product when its launch_date falls in March 2024, first and last day included, and its cost is at least 100 euros.
A range test on launch_date keeps both of its end days, and the cost test joins it with AND. Write the dates as DATE values, and check how many days March has.
faded_shape:
SELECT product_id, product_name, unit_cost_eur, launch_date
FROM products
why_this_works: On a DATE column, BETWEEN the first and last day of March keeps the whole month, and >= 100 keeps a cost of exactly 100.
